//: The WEB tier (CRON_MODE=off, :4000). Identical to nodemon.json except for the sentinel: this one watches dev-restart.web.json, so a change that only the scheduler cares about no longer tears this process down. src is deliberately NOT watched — src/utils/dev/hot-reload.ts swaps what it can in place and touches THIS role's sentinel when it cannot, deciding with src/utils/dev/restart-scope.ts whether the change is even ours. The sentinel must exist before nodemon starts (it resolves its watch list once and silently drops missing entries): backend/scripts/ensure-dev-sentinel.mjs creates all three from predev.
